thread:
Ishaan: Quick note — in-product help panel uses 'route' while console header and docs use 'endpoint'. Users hit this in the onboarding checklist and get mixed signals.
Tess (Design): we should pick one term. Recommend 'endpoint' (matches docs). I'll update microcopy for the panel and CTA.
Ravi (Docs): docs canonical is 'endpoint' — +1. Please add a single canonical link in the panel to /docs/api/endpoints.
Marta (Frontend): implementation: panel title and CTA live in different components; small change but need mapping for older saved links. I'll add utm=console-help.
Sam (A11y): accessibility items: ensure flyout has aria-labelledby="help-endpoint-title" and focus returns to trigger. Also use descriptive link text, not 'more'.
Ishaan: action list: Tess PR microcopy, Marta to update mapping + utm, Sam to sign off on aria/focus. Ravi to add canonical docs link. Target: ship in next patch.
Tess (Design): will put up PR by Thursday.
Marta (Frontend): will schedule brief QA sweep.
Sam (A11y): will run quick screen reader pass after merge.
Ishaan: thanks team :thumbsup:
